text:
alyssa: quick FYI — noticed a small cohort showing doubled token counts in invoice PREVIEW at ~03:12 UTC. Final invoices look OK, but customers are confused and support is getting tickets.

sam: digging. ingest trace shows provisional metering emitted with epoch=null then a join commit a second later with epoch. preview pipeline shows both until async dedupe finishes. example:```
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:01Z ingest req=ri_3f2 epoch=null route=embed-heavy tokens=129
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:02Z joiner commit req=ri_3f2 epoch=epoch-20260322-03 tokens=129
```
mira: that pattern will create duplicate preview rows. final invoice dedupe runs later so no double charge, but UX is bad. any quick mitigations?
jordan: short term: console can collapse preview rows when a matching final commit appears within 5m (match on request_id or client_request_id). Low risk and reversible.
alyssa: long term we should fix at source. two ideas: (1) edge waits a tiny window (20-100ms) for epoch assignment before emitting provisional; (2) attach provisional_epoch as soon as deterministically known and mark events as provisional.
sam: impl notes: edge-proxy change behind flag ingest.bump/provisional_epoch. add counter metering.provisional_emitted and histogram metering.provisional_wait_ms. also need to propagate client_request_id from SDK so retries don't create new ids.
mira: console UX: add route-level toggle "Billing-consistent mode" with copy: "Enable small p50 latency increase (~5-25ms) to reduce duplicate preview items and produce steadier invoice previews." I'll draft modal.
jordan: metering-ingest change: dedupe-before-preview using (request_id, client_request_id, provisional_epoch||epoch). add e2e test that reorders join commit and ingest to ensure preview shows single line.
ops-bot: ticket INC-4821 suppressed alerts for affected tenant cohort (ops link).
alyssa: owners: mira -> console filter + modal copy, sam -> edge change + telemetry, jordan -> ingest dedupe + tests. short-term: console collapse today. medium: feature-flagged infra in 48h. canary 1 week. Ops hold alerts during canary.
sam: quick find — some SDK clients don't send client_request_id on retries. we'll add header and map it in SDKs; fallback will be original request_id.
mira: console collapse PR will include a toggle in preview UI to enable/disable collapse for audit.
jordan: PRs: edge-proxy WIP (will link), metering-ingest WIP (will link). will add logs and a counter metering.duplicate_preview_count for dashboards.
alyssa: ENG-telemetry: please auto-create a small dashboard with panels for provisional_emitted, provisional_wait_ms p50/p95, duplicate_preview_count by route.
ingest-bot: noticed ~0.03% of recent events had epoch delayed >200ms; posting histogram link to infra logs.
alyssa: thanks — let's reconvene 11:00 PT in #eng-platform with PR links. tag me for any new preview spikes and paste sample request_id. :thumbsup:
mira: will post modal mocks + PR link shortly.
sam: starting feature-flagged branch now.
jordan: adding e2e harness tests.
alyssa: leaving thread open for follow-ups.
